summary: Iteration 4: Validated two new features end-to-end + full regression. (1) Vehicle Registration → Market Value lookup via POST /api/vehicles/lookup (auth-required, deterministic) — curated 'WXY1234' → Perodua Myvi 2020 $14,500 / 25% NCD; random 'XYZ7777' returns same car/year/value on repeat calls; <3-char or empty reg returns 400; missing auth returns 401. (2) Admin product editor PATCH /api/products/{id} — base_premium, addons, features, image_url, form_config all partially updateable; non-admin → 403, unauth → 401; persistence verified via GET. Backend enforcement: POST /api/quotes/motor returns 400 when admin-required field (vehicle_reg) is blank+enabled+required. Backend: 71/71 pytest pass (60 regression + 11 new). Frontend: /motor-quote 'Look up' button → green vehicle-lookup-result card (data-testid present), Step 1 sum_insured auto-filled to 14500 with 'AUTO-FILLED FROM LOOKUP' badge, NCD auto-filled to 25. Admin /admin/products → 'Edit product' Sheet drawer with edit-base-premium input, all 26 form_config switches present (enabled-{key} + required-{key} for 13 motor field keys); changing base_premium 180→199 + saving shows 'Product updated' toast and persists across reload; toggling account_type.enabled=OFF on Motor Easy hides the account-personal/business toggle on /motor-quote for customer; re-enabling restores it. Regression: demo+admin login work, motor quote math still 835.65 / 803.25, travel quote, claims, payments, role enforcement all green.
critical_code_review_comments: VehicleLookup endpoint correctly auth-gated, deterministic via SHA1 of normalised reg; depreciation cap 55% on age, ncd_eligible scaled with age — sound. CURATED list covers 6 known regs as spec; CAR_DB has 24 cars for hash fallback.

products.py PATCH coerces ProductAddon and FieldConfig pydantic models to dicts before mongo $set — prevents BSON encode errors. exclude_unset=True+exclude_none=True correctly enables true partial updates.

quotes.py motor enforces form_config via _enabled / _required helpers; required+enabled+blank text fields raise 400. addons zeroed when admin disables addons field. Logic is correct but only 4 text fields are validated for blank — non-text fields rely on Pydantic constraints which is acceptable.
MotorQuote.jsx properly reads form_config via fieldOn/fieldReq helpers and conditionally renders account toggle, ID type, etc. 'Auto-filled from lookup' badge renders when vehicle is set.
AdminProducts.jsx Sheet editor renders 13 motor field switches only when product.category==='motor'. Switch component from ui/switch.jsx correctly toggles {enabled, required} per field.
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (added TestVehicleLookup [6 tests] + TestAdminProductUpdate [5 tests] = 11 new tests)

success_rate.frontend: 100% on lookup + admin editor flows + regression

seed_data_creation: Tests created TEST_-prefixed addon during PATCH and cleaned up by restoring original addons. Travel Shield Global was inadvertently overwritten during a misclick early in UI testing (180 vs original 29) and restored to base_premium=29 via API. form_config on Motor Easy fully restored to all-enabled at end.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests share STATE dict across classes (TestProducts populates travel_product_id, TestMotorProducts populates motor_product_id) — DO NOT run individual classes in isolation; always run full suite or include TestProducts+TestMotorProducts as prerequisites. New tests: TestVehicleLookup (curated regs WXY1234/WAB5678, deterministic random, validation, auth) and TestAdminProductUpdate (PATCH with persistence + cleanup, form_config update, RBAC, blank-required-field 400). On UI: Motor Easy is the 4th product card on /admin/products; use page.locator('button:has-text("Edit product")').nth(3) to open its editor (the broad has_text matcher matches the page wrapper too). All 13 motor form_config keys must have both enabled-{key} and required-{key} testids. After any toggle test, ALWAYS restore form_config to all-enabled.
rca of the issue: No bugs found. Both new features implemented correctly per spec; pricing math, auth gates, persistence, and UI conditional rendering all verified.
